mean_cn: n.关心，关切；  v.关于；涉及；使担心
mean_en: a feeling of worry, especially one that is shared by many people; a desire to protect and help somebody/something
sentence: She showed genuine concern towards her depressed friend.
sentence_trans: 她对沮丧的朋友表现出真诚的关心。
word_etyma: con表强调 + cern区别 → 区分开，只关心自己的部分 → concern关系到
